# `to_csv`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
to_csv(expr[, options])
```

Returns a CSV string with a given struct value

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `csv_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT to_csv(named_struct('a', 1, 'b', 2));
```

Result:

```text
1,2
```

```sql
SELECT to_csv(named_struct('time', to_timestamp('2015-08-26', 'yyyy-MM-dd')), map('timestampFormat', 'dd/MM/yyyy'));
```

Result:

```text
26/08/2015
```
